X.note: The dark grid floor and the glossy cubes are decent, but the 13% label overlaps the green cube and is washed out, with low-contrast teal text on a ghosted panel. The cards cover the cubes, which are all roughly the same height, so they don't show 7/6/13 as quantities. 'ACTUAL' is stamped on every card and again in the corner, which adds noise. The cubes look like dashboard widgets rather than a 3D scene. The caption text is large and readable.

Y.note: The terrain has nice relief and the river is credible. The outlined coin stacks are clean and shadowed, but they are single flat coins with no labels, no numbers, no place names and no legend. You can't tell what place, quantity or document this is, and the only text is a small source line. The lower third is a muddy dark gradient.

why: X at least communicates concrete numbers and context in readable text, despite the overlap, while Y shows unlabeled coins on a map and conveys almost nothing.
top_fix_for_weaker: Add large, high-contrast labels to Y: a place name on the map, and a number or value on or above each coin. Scale or stack the coins by quantity so the count is clear at a glance, and add a one-line title saying what the coins represent.
